{{Quote|Adriphar, get clear of the wreckage! I'll snatch you up!''"<br />"''N-no&hellip; Get back to Grotto&hellip; Warn others&hellip;!|Shonmai and Adriphar|<ref name="Legacy 33" />}}
'''Adriphar''' was a [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] and one of the [[Mon Calamari Rangers]] who protected their people during the [[Genocide on Dac]] in [[137 ABY]]. He disagreed with a decision advised by the [[Imperial Knight]] [[Treis Sinde]]<ref name="Legacy 33" /> to send refugees away rather than shelter them.<ref name="Legacy 32">[[Legacy (2006) 32|''Legacy'' (2006) 32]]</ref> Adriphar and his fellow ranger [[Shonmai]] were scouting the area near the [[Devil's Crevasse]] when they spotted the [[Sea Leviathan]], created by the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Scientist/Legends|Scientist]] [[Vul Isen]]. They decided to return to their base in [[Ranger Grotto]] to inform Sinde of the creature, but the nearby [[Aquatic Terrain Armored Transport]] shot down Adriphar's [[Krakana underwater fighter|Krakana]], which crashed onto the massive Leviathan near one of its life-draining blisters. Adriphar called for Shonmai to return to the Grotto, before his life energy was sucked out by the Leviathan.<ref name="Legacy 33" />

==Behind the scenes==
Adriphar appeared in the [[2009]] [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] [[Legacy (2006) 33|''Legacy'' (2006) 33]], the second issue of ''[[Star Wars: Legacy]]''{{'s}} [[Star Wars: Legacy: Fight Another Day|''Fight Another Day'']] story arc.<ref name="Legacy 33" />
